FRAME BY FRAME · EXACT INTEGER RATES

Frame Timecode Calculator

Cross the next second without losing a frame.

Only 24, 25, 30, 50 and 60 fps. No fractional rates, drop-frame, semicolons or media import. This is not full SMPTE compliance.

Only page memory. No storage, transmission, clipboard or autosave. Reload restores defaults; browser memory is not secure erasure.

JavaScript is required to calculate. Static instructions remain available; no result is being calculated.

1 · Set your frame convention

Timecode is HH:MM:SS:FF, not milliseconds. Choose the rate explicitly. Active fields allow at most 16 raw characters. Frame index starts at zero; valid timecodes stay within 00:00:00:00–23:59:59:FF.

Single-line browser inputs remove CR/LF line breaks before this tool receives their value. Other received characters are kept; only surrounding ASCII whitespace is ignored for calculation.

Source input mode

Switching modes preserves each input, but does not convert the previous result. Changing rate preserves the literal input and reinterprets it; elapsed time is not preserved.

    2 · Source → shifted frame

    Indices refer to frame starts, not inclusive frame counts or clip duration. Exact fractions are seconds since frame 0. No wrapping across midnight or silent clamping.
